title: AAN Practice Advisory 2022: Stroke Prevention in Symptomatic Large Artery Intracranial Atherosclerosis

recommendations.text: Clinicians should recommend aspirin 325 mg/d for long-term prevention of stroke and death, and should add clopidogrel 75 mg/d for up to 90 days to further reduce stroke risk in patients with severe (70-99%) sICAS who have low risk of haemorrhagic transformation.

Clinicians should recommend high-intensity statin therapy targeting LDL-C <70 mg/dL, a long-term blood pressure target <140/90 mmHg, at least moderate physical activity, and treatment of other modifiable vascular risk factors.
Clinicians should NOT recommend percutaneous transluminal angioplasty and stenting for stroke prevention in moderate (50-69%) sICAS, or as initial treatment in severe sICAS.
Clinicians should not routinely recommend angioplasty alone or indirect bypass outside clinical trials, and should not recommend direct bypass for stroke prevention in sICAS.
